dogecoin.text: I’ve mined almost 6 dogecoins. I will exchange a shiny dogecoin for goods and/or services.
I hope Dogecoin crashes someday, so I can finally say "time to get the hell out of Doge."

Musk buying Twitter will probably just result in a “tip with Dogecoin” button that you can safely ignore, just like almost every other feature they’ve released since users and third-party developers invented replying and retweeting 15 years ago.
